verdict.rationale: The discovery docs mention searching and listing Bazaar resources "with a generated OpenAPI client" (docs-22), which implies an OpenAPI spec exists for the discovery API. However, no downloadable spec location is documented, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on the docs domain all returned 404 (probe-3). Those were guessed paths, so this is a gap rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: a documented, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec URL, spec coverage of the facilitator and protocol endpoints, and hands-on confirmation that the spec can be fetched.
